程序包 top.brmc.bukkitplatform.zombies.game.luckychest

类 LuckyChestSettings

java.lang.Object
top.brmc.devlib.settings.FileConfig
top.brmc.devlib.settings.YamlConfig
top.brmc.bukkitplatform.zombies.game.luckychest.LuckyChestSettings
public final class LuckyChestSettings extends top.brmc.devlib.settings.YamlConfig
幸运箱全局参数,来自插件数据目录的 luckychest.yml.

读写方式与 EconomySettings 一致:首次加载补齐缺失键并落盘,之后只读取, 因此服主手改的数值不会被覆盖.

线程约束:字段在 load() 中整体刷新, 读取方都在服务端主线程, 因此这里不做同步.
